entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Sales', 'Support', or 'Returns' to be connected to the right department.
Connecting you to a returns specialist now.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah, I need to return a helmet I purchased a little while ago.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the Aero-Dynamic Helmet, placed on October 26th. Can I ask what the reason for the return is?
It was a gift, and it turned out to be the wrong color. The box is still unopened, so it's in perfect condition.

I understand completely. Let me just check our policy. Okay, great news. It looks like you are well within our 90-day return window. I've just approved the return for you. I'm sending a prepaid return label to the email address on file right now. You should see it in the next few minutes.

That's fantastic, thank you Sarah. Now, since I'll be ordering the correct helmet from you right away, is there any chance you could offer a small discount code for the new purchase? Say, 10% for the trouble?

I'm happy I could process the return for you. While I can't provide a discount code, your full refund will be processed as soon as the warehouse receives the original item. You can then place your new order for the helmet with the right color.

I see. What about waiving the return shipping fee? Or upgrading the shipping on my new order? VeloFit's commitment to safety is why I'm sticking with your brand, so a little something would be appreciated.

The return shipping is already covered by the prepaid label I sent, so there's no cost to you to send the unopened box back. I am unable to apply credits or upgrades to a future order, however. The return and the new purchase would be two separate transactions.
Alright, fair enough. Covered return shipping works for me. I appreciate you approving the return so quickly.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day!
